exposure: Pituitary stalk interruption syndrome (PSIS) without overweight/obesity
Pituitary stalk interruption syndrome (PSIS) with obesity or overweight
cohort: 69 children and young adults with PSIS
finding: Patients with PSIS who are obese/overweight display a higher incidence of neonatal hypoglycemia and extrapituitary malformations compared to those without overweight/obesity.
mod_finding: The incidence of cesarean section was higher in the obese/overweight group (52%) than in the non-obese/overweight group (23%), although not statistically significant.
